causal_contract.corporate_actions: ETN-USDT and STRAX-USDT are excluded before candidate selection; their pre/post identity segments are never concatenated.
causal_contract.entry_reference: entry_price is the next completed 1h candle open; A2 does not simulate fills or exits.
causal_contract.monthly_asset_gate: Every signal joins to exactly one A1B symbol-month decision based only on information ending at that month start.
causal_contract.signal_execution: A family signal is evaluated only from completed 1h data and completed higher-timeframe context at or before signal_close.

feature_warmup_policy.condition: RD16C causal feature construction leaves zero rows and every A1B month for the symbol is explicitly ineligible.
feature_warmup_policy.contradiction_policy: Fail closed if any A1B month is eligible while no causal feature rows exist.
feature_warmup_policy.output: Write deterministic zero-row candidate and audit partitions, retain the symbol in the 341 READY_LOCAL partition index, and record the status in symbol-generation-summary.csv.

COMPRESSION_EXPANSION_SPECIALIST_V3.router_cooldown: 24-hour signal cooldown is deterministic and independent of position outcomes, so it is executed during generation

TREND_CONTINUATION_CORE_V3.fee_buffer: required outside STRONG_BULL and waived inside STRONG_BULL, matching the retained RD16H evidence-expansion source
TREND_CONTINUATION_CORE_V3.router_cooldown: 12 hours, recorded as pending and not executed in A2 because admission state belongs to sealed replay

objective: Build deterministic pre-router signal candidates for the frozen COMPOSITE_ALPHA_V3 Trend and Compression engines across the corrected C2 universe, using only sealed local market data, the A1B causal monthly asset gate, and the A1C explicit corporate-action exclusions.
required_validation: all 341 READY_LOCAL symbols are processed or resume-verified
every selected signal has an explicit eligible A1B symbol-month row
ETN-USDT and STRAX-USDT never appear in selected candidates
all higher-timeframe context timestamps are at or before signal_close
no signal or entry bar crosses the sealed cutoff
no exit, PnL, return, position, or router-outcome columns are written
candidate partitions equal the selected rows in their audit partitions
all output hashes and content hashes match the deterministic manifest
READY_LOCAL symbols with zero rows after causal feature warm-up are explicit zero-candidate partitions only when all A1B months are ineligible

runtime_outputs.partitioning: one candidate and one audit parquet per READY_LOCAL pair
